newsitem.title: USA: Koss Corp says licensing pact transferred.
newsitem.headline: Koss Corp says licensing pact transferred.

text.p: Koss Corp said Tuesday it has signed an agreement that allows for the transfer of its licensing agreement with Trabelco NV, a unit of Hagemeyer NV, to Jiangsu Electronics Industries Ltd.
The pact allows for continued production and distribution of compact disc-based portable electronics, pocket stereos and other products in North America, Central America and South America, Koss said.
Koss said an agreement for the transfer of the licensing agreement to Jiangsu was signed on Friday, May 9. Jiangsu Electronics is a unit of Orient Power Holdings Ltd.
